study_status: Diagnostic follow-up after inspecting v1 test errors; test periods are not untouched
test_and_validation_origins: Exact frozen hourly origins from expanded Chronos cases
training_boundary: All targets through 168h end by train_cutoff, before validation origins
refit_boundary: All eligible hourly origins with targets through 168h ending by validation_cutoff, before first test origin
target: Residual from target-aligned weekly naive; add weekly prediction back at inference
features: Origin load lags and 24/168/336h statistics, daily/weekly/prior-week target-aligned loads, differences, horizon, cyclic hour/weekday/year and weekend
selection: Validation MAE only; Ridge scaler fitted only on training; newly fitted on refit data
training_budget: All eligible hourly origins; duplicate target hours across forecast horizons are training rows, not independent statistical evidence
missing_data: No filling; require complete 336h history and 168h future during training; report excluded cases
caveats: Q1 has no earlier fitting data under frozen split; do not move its boundaries
Later windows may train on earlier test-period observations once those observations are historical
Not an exhaustive model search or proof about all trained models
Trained-model uncertainty not calculated by this script
Corrects origin-hour coverage but does not resolve all model specification or extrapolation limitations
change_from_v1: Use every eligible hourly training/refit origin instead of midnight-only daily origins; features, model settings grids, test cases and MAE selection remain unchanged
